evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep said 'I can definitely help you to provide you a code and I just needed to ask you a few questions in order for us to build an accurate quote you can depend on, sounds good.' — framing is present but rep moved into discovery ('may just ask recording your move. Do you have any concerns...') without waiting for explicit affirmation before diving into agenda.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked 'Do you have any concerns or any important things that you wanted to answer during this call today?' but this came after initial greeting and was asked before name/date/route probing; customer said 'I may have a few questions as the conversation continues, but I don't know right now' — no concerns surfaced.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer explicitly stated no concerns at the time ('I may have a few questions as the conversation continues, but I don't know right now'), so no follow-up gap exists.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns were raised to reflect back.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (one-story house), floor/stories (one-story), bedrooms (3 at origin, 4 at destination), walking distance (right in front), additional rooms (garage, patio furniture), special items (TVs, washer/dryers, sectional, bed, grill), parking details covered — all seven items covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Yes, asked explicitly: 'And do you need help in packing like putting the small items into your boxes?'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Yes: 'with regards to the number of your boxes typically that is between fifty to sixty boxes do you feel that you fall within that range?'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full — rep gave typical range ('typically that is between two and a half between six and a half to eight and a half hours') and personalized to customer's situation (two-day split for full packing, 30-min distance, one-story both ends, specific items like wall-mounted TV).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full — disclosed hourly rate ($102 per hour per mover), box truck included with gas/taxes/insurance/wraps/pads/tools/disassembly, packing cost ($320), minimum 2.5 hours, 15-minute increment proration, and explicitly stated 'no hidden fees,' 'no credit card fees,' 'no sterile fees,' 'no reassembly fees.'
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked — rep moved directly from pricing explanation into scheduling discussion without asking 'Does that feel fair?' or similar, and did not hold silence for customer to respond.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Full — rep stated: 'we have on time guarantee we value your time. So, if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Full — rep stated: 'we have no really damage coverage included on the R-D. Ate... We will provide up to $2,000 per move that is to repair replace and reimburse for items' (no deductible/fine print framing implied by 'included on the rate').
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: False — rep did not ask a version of 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar closing confirmation; instead moved directly into scheduling and the explicit ask without looping back.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Full — asked plainly: 'Would you like our help with your move? Would you like to lock that in for you' with no softened out or alternative.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: True — rep stated: 'there's no deposit required, no risk and securing your spot so, in case if something comes up you have to change the date and you wanted to reschedule or to cancel then all you have to do is just simply give us a call there's no fees of for both of that either.'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial — date (Oct 28 packing, Oct 29 moving) confirmed, phone number NOT explicitly confirmed, arrival window (8:30–9:00 AM mentioned but not explicitly confirmed as locked), crew size (2 movers) confirmed, origin address (11212 Amber Valley Drive, Frisco) mentioned in discovery, destination address mentioned by customer ('new location') but NOT formally confirmed in booking, no notes left with crew about customer's concerns.

top_strength: Excellent logistics probing and detail gathering — rep systematically covered property type, rooms, parking, access, special items, and special considerations across both locations, enabling an accurate and confident estimate.
coaching_note: Section 6 and the final silence discipline are missing: never asked 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or catch-all ('Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'), and never held silence after pricing or used 'Does that feel fair?' — close calls with affirmative silence to give customers space to express doubt before the ask.
